title: Ziemba: No Immediate US Role in Saudi-Houthi Fighting
summary: Aramco's headquarters in the eastern part of Saudi Arabia was hit by a Houthi missile attack. Authorities said the strike on Dhahran caused a limited fire and no injuries as fighting between the Iran-backed rebels in Yemen & Saudi-led coalition intensified. Rachel Ziemba founder of Ziemba Insights spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East and Africa on the likelihood of the US getting involved in the fighting. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Belgium's Wunsch on ECB Policy Outlook

 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Energy Companies Set to Lead European Earnings Growth Again
summary: Energy companies are poised to lead European earnings growth for a third straight quarter, as elevated energy prices stemming from the conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine bolster profits across the sector.

title: Rudd Warns of Tariff Risks Amid 'Stable' US-China Ties

title: Billionaire Birla Plans $30 Billion Push Undeterred by Crises

title: What China's 'Extraordinary' Trade Surplus Means

title: 'With Canada, There's Trust': Trade Minister Sidhu

title: Hong Kong’s Clearing Bank Gains New Funding Access in Yuan Push
